
# ============================================================================
#  Start Add Class Definitions
# ============================================================================

Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add class "Default Routing and Remote Access Class" "User class for remote access clients" 525241532e4d6963726f736f6674 0 b
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add class "Default BOOTP Class" "User class for BOOTP Clients" 424f4f54502e4d6963726f736f6674 0 b
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add class "IP-Phones" "Polycom phones" 506f6c79636f6d 1 b

# ============================================================================
#  Start Add Optiondef
# ============================================================================

Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add optiondef 1 "Subnet Mask" IPADDRESS 0 comment="Subnet mask in network byte order" 0.0.0.0
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add optiondef 6 "DNS Servers" IPADDRESS 1 comment="Array of DNS servers, by preference"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add optiondef 252 "WPAD" STRING 0 comment="Web Proxy Auto Discovery"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add optiondef 224 "site-code" STRING 0 comment="Site"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add optiondef 1 "Microsoft Disable Netbios Option " DWORD 0 vendor="Microsoft Windows 2000 Options" comment="Option for enabling or disabling Netbios" 1

# ============================================================================
#  Start Set OptionValues
# ============================================================================

Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local set optionvalue 6 IPADDRESS "10.10.0.10" "10.10.0.11"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local set optionvalue 15 STRING "example.local"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local set optionvalue 51 DWORD "86400"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local set optionvalue 224 STRING "berlin"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local set optionvalue 252 STRING "http://wpad.example.local/wpad.dat"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local set optionvalue 1 DWORD vendor="Microsoft Windows 2000 Options" "1"

Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local set auditlog "C:\Windows\system32\dhcp"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local set dnsconfig 1 0 1 0

Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add filter allow 00-15-5D-01-02-03 "Hyper-V test VM"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add filter deny 02-AA-BB-CC-DD-EE "Blocked"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local set filter enforceallowlist=0 enforcedenylist=1

# ============================================================================
#  Start Add Scope 10.10.1.0
# ============================================================================

Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add scope 10.10.1.0 255.255.255.0 "Office" "Main office"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.1.0 set state 1
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.1.0 add iprange 10.10.1.20 10.10.1.240 DHCP
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.1.0 add excluderange 10.10.1.20 10.10.1.30
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.1.0 set optionvalue 51 DWORD "691200"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.1.0 set optionvalue 3 IPADDRESS "10.10.1.1"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.1.0 set optionvalue 66 STRING "10.10.0.5" user="IP-Phones"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.1.0 Add reservedip 10.10.1.10 00155d0a0b0c "printer01.example.local" "Printer 1st floor" "BOTH"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.1.0 Reservedip 10.10.1.10 set optionvalue 3 IPADDRESS "10.10.1.254"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.1.0 set superscope "Building A" 1
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.1.0 set delayoffer 0

# ============================================================================
#  Start Add Scope 10.10.2.0
# ============================================================================

Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add scope 10.10.2.0 255.255.255.128 "Lab" ""
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.2.0 set state 0
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.2.0 add iprange 10.10.2.10 10.10.2.100 BOTH 0
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.2.0 set optionvalue 51 DWORD "4294967295"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.2.0 set optionvalue 3 IPADDRESS "10.10.2.1"
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local Scope 10.10.2.0 set superscope "Building A" 1

Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local add mscope "Multicast" "" 1
Dhcp Server \\DHCP01.example.local v6 set optionvalue 23 IPV6ADDRESS "2001:db8::53"
